{{Top|leg}}
'''Sporofor Spetzna''' was a speciality restaurant located on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. It specialized in dishes that were to be eaten by beings able to digest or assimilate [[cellulose]], such as [[drapsha]] and [[spetzna]].
